contract.input: Only policy.input is model-visible; action/weight training labels; never train on evaluator-only challenge rows.
contract.action_space: Same host legal movement, PAINT_A, PAINT_B, ERASE, STOP. No new policy action token.
contract.grouping: Retain train/dev/heldout source split and group by source_seed/geometry_sha256 across all corpus versions; v51 sources use v46 candidate indices >=300.
contract.active_probe: A non-diagnostic surface alert is visible at a target. Teacher returns through its observed graph to the safe site, issues actual PAINT_A, receives the host physical result, ERASEs, returns, and selects material-correct target paint.
contract.protection: Synthetic protected-goal test: wrong physical paint after a surface warning terminates the episode unsuccessfully; no failed examples disguised as successes.
contract.negatives: Warning with no law change must still cause safe validation but must not change the correct material command. No-alert baseline avoids unnecessary probe.
contract.causal: Matched no-drift/drift arms are input-identical before the safe probe; after it, removing the new physical outcome makes target inputs identical although legal correct commands differ.
contract.leak: Hidden mapping/flip/protection-damage and scenario labels appear only in evaluator metadata, never in input.

limitations: Synthetic graph/material adapter NOT native CyberSand; warnings and failure semantics hypothetical, require native ABI validation.
Prelude survey and historical calibrations are scripted host-executed operations, not learned exploration.
One per-surface safe test still suffices; labels are symbolic observable-state teacher not neural success.
No LFM/Sprocket training, SLM p95 latency/RSS, native episodes, or immutable Actions shard artifacts.
